pairs.target: zǎobān dìyīshēng shàoxiǎng shí , tǎ wéi zhèng bǎ xiùkǒu wǎng shàngjuàn .
pairs.english: At the first whistle of the early shift, Tavi was rolling up his cuffs.
pairs.hanzi: 早班第一声哨响时，塔维正把袖口往上卷。

pairs.target: dù chéng gěi tā yíkuài néng yǐ zhe xiězì de báobǎn , ràng tā zhàn zài huángxiàn hòumiàn , xiān jì yìzhī huòxiāng cóng jìn gǔ dào líkāi yào duōjiǔ , bié yí dào tíngdùn biàn dītóu , bǎ xià yíbù lòu le .
pairs.english: Du Cheng gave him a thin board to write against and told him to stand behind the yellow line, first timing a cargo carriage from entering the valley to leaving. He must not look down at every pause and miss the next step.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄给他一块能倚着写字的薄板，让他站在黄线后面，先记一只货厢从进谷到离开要多久，别一到停顿便低头，把下一步漏了。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng gēnzhe wēn xiù chákàn xièhuò jià , tā biàn dúzì shǒu zhe nàtiáo xiàn .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng went with Wenxiu to inspect the unloading rack, leaving him alone at the line.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡跟着温岫查看卸货架，他便独自守着那条线。

pairs.target: gāo jiàshàng de bùtiáo lǎnlǎn chuí zhe , duìàn xiān huàng le huàng zhǎi qí , zhè tóu què shēngqǐ yímiàn hóngqí , huòxiāng méiyǒu guòlái .
pairs.english: The cloth strips drooped lazily on the tower. The far bank waved its narrow flag first, but this end raised a red one, and the carriage did not come across.
pairs.hanzi: 高架上的布条懒懒垂着，对岸先晃了晃窄旗，这头却升起一面红旗，货厢没有过来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài shíkè páng xiě le yígè fēng zì , dīng le piànkè , yòu tiān shàng wèi xíng .
pairs.english: Beside the time, Tavi wrote “wind,” stared a moment, then added “not moving.”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在时刻旁写了一个风字，盯了片刻，又添上未行。

pairs.target: bèihòu yǒurén wèn : " nǐ zhēn lěng , háishì zhǐ lěng ? " tā huítóu , kànjiàn yígè bǐ zìjǐ dàbùliǎo duōshǎo de gūniáng , bèizhe biǎn pídài , zhèng wǎng xiédài lǐ sāi yì jié sōngkāi de shéng tóu .
pairs.english: Someone asked behind him, “Are you cold, or is the paper?” Turning, he saw a girl not much older than himself, with a flat leather bag on her back, tucking a loose rope end into her shoelace.
pairs.hanzi:
背后有人问：“你真冷，还是纸冷？”
他回头，看见一个比自己大不了多少的姑娘，背着扁皮袋，正往鞋带里塞一截松开的绳头。

pairs.target: tā jiào xià róng , tì zhè yídài jǐjiā huò xíng dì jíjiàn , méi chūmén de shíhòu , yě jiē huòchǎng àn bān suànqián de huó .
pairs.english: Her name was Xiarong. She carried urgent messages for several local freight firms and, when not away, also took freight-yard work paid by the shift.
pairs.hanzi: 她叫夏绒，替这一带几家货行递急件，没出门的时候，也接货场按班算钱的活。

pairs.target: tā shuōhuà bú màn , shǒu gèng kuài , yìbiān jiāng shōujiàn mùpái rēngjìn dù chéng de xiázǐ , yìbiān cháo tā de bǎnzǐ diǎn xiàbā .
pairs.english: She spoke quickly and her hands were quicker still, dropping a receipt tag into Du Cheng's box while jerking her chin at Tavi's board.
pairs.hanzi: 她说话不慢，手更快，一边将收件木牌扔进杜澄的匣子，一边朝他的板子点下巴。

pairs.target: " hóngqí shì zhè yìtóu hái zhàn zhe . zuótiān shéng shàng nà jǐtiáo cái kàn fēng . "
pairs.english: “Red means this end is still occupied. Those strips on the line yesterday are for the wind.”
pairs.hanzi: “红旗是这一头还占着。昨天绳上那几条才看风。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tái yǎnkàn , hóngqí xià guǒzhēn háiyǒu yìzhī jiēchē méi tuīkāi .
pairs.english: Tavi looked up; sure enough, a receiving trolley had not yet been moved away beneath the red flag.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维抬眼看，红旗下果真还有一只接车没推开。

pairs.target: chē shàngkōng xiāng yǐ xièwán , gōngrén zhèngzài shōulǒng duǎn xiè guǐ , dé xiān bǎ kōng xiāng guàhuí suǒ shàng sòngzǒu , cái lún dédào duìàn xià yìzhī .
pairs.english: The carriage on it had been emptied, and workers were folding away the short unloading rails. They had to hang the empty carriage back on the cable and send it off before the next one across the valley could take its turn.
pairs.hanzi: 车上空厢已卸完，工人正在收拢短卸轨，得先把空厢挂回索上送走，才轮得到对岸下一只。

pairs.target: tā yuánlái yǐwéi nà miàn qí zhǐyào wǎng shàng yìjǔ , jiù dōu shì zuórì nàzhǒng fēng tíng .
pairs.english: He had thought that whenever that flag went up, it meant a wind stoppage like yesterday's.
pairs.hanzi: 他原来以为那面旗只要往上一举，就都是昨日那种风停。

pairs.target: tā huà qù fēng zì , xià róng yǐjīng zǒu dào tái biān , jiēguò yígè gōngrén dì lái de xìshéng , zài sōngdòng de bǎng jié wài yòu rào le yìquān .
pairs.english: He crossed out “wind.” Xiarong had already gone to the platform edge, taken a thin cord from a worker and wound another turn around a loose knot.
pairs.hanzi: 他划去风字，夏绒已经走到台边，接过一个工人递来的细绳，在松动的绑结外又绕了一圈。

pairs.target: dù chéng jiào tā děng bān jiéshù zài chāi xiédài , tā dá shuō nà búshì xiédài , shì tā zǎoshàng zhǎo búdào de nàgēn shéng , rě dé lìng yígè rén xiào qǐlái .
pairs.english: Du Cheng told her to wait until the shift ended before untying her shoelaces. She said it was not a shoelace but the cord he could not find that morning, making another worker laugh.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄叫她等班结束再拆鞋带，她答说那不是鞋带，是他早上找不到的那根绳，惹得另一个人笑起来。

pairs.target: kōng xiāng sòngzǒu hòu , xīn de yìzhī jìnlái . jiēchē tuō wěn xiāng dǐ , guàliàn fàngsōng , cèmén dǎkāi , liǎnggè bān gōng jiāng duǎn xiè guǐ cóng xiāng mén dā dào táishàng de fēn huòjià .
pairs.english: After the empty carriage left, a new one came in. The receiving trolley supported its base, the hanging chains slackened and the side door opened. Two porters laid short unloading rails from the carriage door to the sorting rack on the platform.
pairs.hanzi: 空厢送走后，新的一只进来。接车托稳厢底，挂链放松，侧门打开，两个搬工将短卸轨从厢门搭到台上的分货架。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái kànqīng , huòxiāng luò zài jiē chēshàng hé xiāngzǐ líkāi huòxiāng , yuánlái shì liǎngdào fēnkāi de shì .
pairs.english: Only now did Tavi see clearly that the carriage landing on the trolley and crates leaving the carriage were two separate operations.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这才看清，货厢落在接车上和箱子离开货厢，原来是两道分开的事。

pairs.target: dìyī zhī fāng xiāng hěn shùn , yán liǎngtiáo mù guǐ tuīguòqù , zhī xū zài biānshàng fú yìbǎ .
pairs.english: The first square crate went smoothly, pushed along the two wooden rails with only a steadying hand at the side.
pairs.hanzi: 第一只方箱很顺，沿两条木轨推过去，只需在边上扶一把。

pairs.target: dìèrzhī cháng xiāng què tíngzhù le , xiāngdǐ yìtiáo jiù cáo yā dào guǐ biān , lìngyìbiān yòu xuán chū tài duō , gōngrén tuī le liǎngxià , xiāng shēn biàn xiàng zuǒ wāi .
pairs.english: The second long crate stopped, however: an old slot in its base pressed against a rail edge while the other side overhung too far. After two pushes, the crate tilted left.
pairs.hanzi: 第二只长箱却停住了，箱底一条旧槽压到轨边，另一边又悬出太多，工人推了两下，箱身便向左歪。

pairs.target: dù chéng jiàotíng , ná mùxiē diàn zhù , shuí yě méi zài yònglì yìngtuī .
pairs.english: Du Cheng called a halt and propped it with a wooden wedge; no one tried forcing it any farther.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄叫停，拿木楔垫住，谁也没再用力硬推。

pairs.target: zuìhòu tāmen zài xiāng lǐ dǎkāi cháng xiāng , bǎ lǐtou yíshù shù miánxù bāo xièxiàlái , fēnkāi bān guò xiè guǐ , zài zài jiàshàng zhuāng huí xiāng lǐ .
pairs.english: In the end they opened the long crate inside the carriage, unloaded its bundles of cotton wadding, carried them separately over the unloading rails and repacked them on the rack.
pairs.hanzi: 最后他们在厢里打开长箱，把里头一束束棉絮包卸下来，分开搬过卸轨，再在架上装回箱里。

pairs.target: bāo bú zhòng , què zhàn dìfāng , gōngrén yìqiányīhòu dì zhe , lìngyìrén yìzhí ànzhù méi xiè kōng de xiāng yán . xià róng ná zhe zhúpiàn qīngdiǎn , yǎnjīng méi líkāi tāmen de shǒu .
pairs.english: The bundles were light but bulky. Workers passed them front to back while another held the rim of the partly emptied crate. Xiarong counted with bamboo tallies, never looking away from their hands.
pairs.hanzi: 包不重，却占地方，工人一前一后递着，另一人一直按住没卸空的箱沿。夏绒拿着竹片清点，眼睛没离开他们的手。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuánxiān jì de nà yìháng zǎo xiě mǎn le , biàn zhuǎn dào zhǐbèi , cóng kāixiāng jìxù jì .
pairs.english: Tavi had long since filled his original line, so he turned the paper over and continued recording from the opening of the crate.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原先记的那一行早写满了，便转到纸背，从开箱继续记。

pairs.target: hóngqí yìzhí liú zhe , gǔ shàng de fēng jīhū méiyǒu , tā què yǐ néng tīngjiàn duìàn hòu tái chuánlái de qiāo língshēng , yìshēng bǐ yìshēng jí .
pairs.english: The red flag stayed up. There was barely any wind over the valley, but he could already hear bells ringing from the opposite waiting platform, each more urgent than the last.
pairs.hanzi: 红旗一直留着，谷上的风几乎没有，他却已能听见对岸候台传来的敲铃声，一声比一声急。

pairs.target: hǎoróngyì shōuwán , dù chéng huí shào , jiānbǎng wǎng xià yì chén . xià róng qù xǐliǎn , zǒuguò tǎ wéi shēnbiān shíshuō , ruò tā xiě dé xià , bùfáng bǎ děng fàn yě xiě shàng , jīnrì fàn tān de rètāng yòu gāi màiwán le .
pairs.english: Finally finished, Du Cheng answered with a whistle, his shoulders sinking. Xiarong went to wash her face and said as she passed Tavi that, if he had room, he might record waiting for lunch too: the food stall's hot soup would be sold out again today.
pairs.hanzi: 好容易收完，杜澄回哨，肩膀往下一沉。夏绒去洗脸，走过塔维身边时说，若他写得下，不妨把等饭也写上，今日饭摊的热汤又该卖完了。

pairs.target: wǔjiān , ruǎn héng huílái kàn tā de jìlù . tā bǎ huàdiào de fēng zì yě tānchūlái , shuō zìjǐ cuò kàn le xìnhào .
pairs.english: At noon Ruan Heng came back to see his records. He showed him the crossed-out “wind” too, admitting he had misread the signal.
pairs.hanzi: 午间，阮衡回来看他的记录。他把划掉的风字也摊出来，说自己错看了信号。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng méi tì tā miáo gānjìng , zhī wèn dìèrzhī xiāngzǐ de dǐ cáo liáng le méiyǒu . hái méi liáng , xiāngzǐ yǐ gěi huòzhǔ tái zǒu , wēn xiù biàn dài tā qù kàn pángbiān yìzhī dài chāi de tóng shì jiù xiāng , héduì dǐxià de sìtiáo cáo .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng did not clean it up for him, only asked whether he had measured the second crate's base slots. He had not, and its owner had already taken it away, so Wenxiu showed him another old crate of the same type awaiting unpacking nearby, to check the four slots beneath.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡没替他描干净，只问第二只箱子的底槽量了没有。还没量，箱子已给货主抬走，温岫便带他去看旁边一只待拆的同式旧箱，核对底下的四条槽。

pairs.target: " jiù jiàshàng yǒu sìpái kǎ chǐ , xiāngdǐ zhào tā zuò . " tā shuō , " xiànzài jiēchē néng jiē xiāng , xiè guǐ què zhī huàn le liǎngtiáo . gèzì dōu shì hǎo de , fàngdào yìqǐ , bù yídìng . "
pairs.english: “The old rack had four rows of locking teeth, and the crate bases were made for it,” she said. “Now the trolley can receive the carriage, but they only replaced the unloading rails with two. Each is fine separately. Together, not necessarily.”
pairs.hanzi: “旧架上有四排卡齿，箱底照它做。”她说，“现在接车能接厢，卸轨却只换了两条。各自都是好的，放到一起，不一定。”

pairs.target: xiàwǔ , nà liǎnggè bān gōng lái lǐng chāizhuāng de qián . yígè zhǐzhe shàngwǔ de xiāng hào , shuō fēn le bābāo , gāi suàn bājiàn , dù chéng quèshuō zuì wàimiàn yuán bào liù shù , lìng liǎngbāo shì hòulái kǔn sōng de , dé jiào jìzhàng de rén lái duì .
pairs.english: That afternoon the two porters came for their unpacking and repacking pay. One pointed at the morning crate number: eight bundles should count as eight items. Du Cheng said the outer declaration listed six bundles, with two coming loose later; they needed the bookkeeper to check.
pairs.hanzi: 下午，那两个搬工来领拆装的钱。一个指着上午的箱号，说分了八包，该算八件，杜澄却说最外面原报六束，另两包是后来捆松的，得叫记账的人来对。

pairs.target: liǎng rén méiyǒu chǎo dàshēng , liǎnsè què dōu bùhǎo . tǎ wéi ná zhe chǐ zhàn zài pángbiān , hūrán méifǎ bǎ zǎoshàng nàduàn máfán , zhī dàngchéng zhǐ shàng de yì jié kōng děng .
pairs.english: Neither raised his voice, but both looked unhappy. Standing nearby with his ruler, Tavi suddenly could no longer regard the morning's trouble as just a stretch of idle waiting on paper.
pairs.hanzi:
两人没有吵大声，脸色却都不好。
塔维拿着尺站在旁边，忽然没法把早上那段麻烦，只当成纸上的一截空等。

pairs.target: xiāngzǐ ruò búyòng chāi , tāmen néng zǎodiǎn chīfàn ; kě zhè jǐbǐ chāizhuāng qián , yě shì zhēn yào dàihuíjiā de .
pairs.english: If the crates needed no unpacking, they could eat sooner; but those unpacking fees really were money they needed to take home.
pairs.hanzi: 箱子若不用拆，他们能早点吃饭；可这几笔拆装钱，也是真要带回家的。

pairs.target: xià róng cóng fàn tān līn huí yì hú yǐjīng liáng le de tāng , gěi tāmen dǎo mǎn sānzhī wǎn , dìsì zhī dìgěi tā .
pairs.english: Xiarong brought back a pot of soup already cold from the stall, filled three bowls for them and handed him a fourth.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒从饭摊拎回一壶已经凉了的汤，给他们倒满三只碗，第四只递给他。

pairs.target: tāng lǐ piāozhe yípiàn cōng , tǎ wéi dītóu hē le yìkǒu , juédìng xiàwǔ de dìèrzhāng zhǐ yào lìng liú yìlán , xiān bú tì shuí bǎ nà bābāo gǎichéng liù bāo .
pairs.english: A scallion leaf floated in the soup. Tavi lowered his head to drink and decided to leave a separate column on the afternoon's second sheet, without changing those eight bundles to six for anyone yet.
pairs.hanzi: 汤里漂着一片葱，塔维低头喝了一口，决定下午的第二张纸要另留一栏，先不替谁把那八包改成六包。
